title: Factorial constant asymptotic equivalent
statement: As $d$ tends to infinity through the natural numbers, $\frac{(3d)!^2}{(d!)^6}$ is asymptotic to $\frac{3}{4\pi^2}\,\frac{3^{6d}}{d^2}$, meaning that the ratio of the two quantities tends to $1$.
